physical_problem: 3D periodic wall-resolved channel flow at Re_tau=180, body-force driven, compared against Moser-Kim-Mansour (1999) DNS

observable.primary: u+ profile RMS error vs DNS in y+ ∈ [30, 100]
secondary: Reynolds stress -u'v'+ RMS error vs DNS

grid_levels.expected: under-resolved (domain too small), but fast probe for transition
half DNS size, should capture large-scale structures
near DNS size (MKM: Lx/h=12.6, Lz/h=4.2), target accuracy

decision_criteria.promote: ≥2 grid levels with u+ RMS error ≤3% AND monotone convergence
decision_criteria.terminal: no transition (Reynolds stress ≈0) OR error >3% non-monotone OR instability
